textbookBox.concept: In the Mokokchung district of Nagaland, people play a game called Hekko, a well-known sport today. Hek means to challenge and ko means tiger, so Hekko means challenging the tiger.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: In the Mokokchung district of Nagaland, people play a game called Hekko, a well-known sport today. Hek means to challenge and ko means tiger, so Hekko means challenging the tiger.
beats.speakEn: In the Mokokchung district of Nagaland, people play a game called Hekko, a well-known sport today. Hek means to challenge and ko means tiger, so Hekko means challenging the tiger.

beats.en: Hekko is played between two teams, Aami and Aakho, with eleven players in each team. A toss decides which team will be Aami and which will be Aakho. A circle is drawn.

textbookBox.concept: The game ends when all Aakho players are caught, or all Aami players are pushed out, or the time runs out. The team with the most points wins.
